doc.brief: Configures how rows are displayed in a [`ColumnView`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView).
doc.md:
Configures how rows are displayed in a [`ColumnView`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView).

It is not used to set the widgets displayed in the individual cells. For that
see [`GtkColumnViewColumn.set_factory()`](xref:gtk:GtkColumnViewColumn#method:set_factory) and [`GtkColumnViewCell`](xref:gtk:GtkColumnViewCell).

get_activatable.brief: Checks if the row has been set to be activatable via gtk_column_view_row_set_activatable().
get_activatable.md:
Checks if the row has been set to be activatable via
gtk_column_view_row_set_activatable().

get_focusable.brief: Checks if a row item has been set to be focusable via gtk_column_view_row_set_focusable().
get_focusable.md:
Checks if a row item has been set to be focusable via
gtk_column_view_row_set_focusable().

get_item.brief: Gets the model item that associated with `self`.
get_item.md:
Gets the model item that associated with `self`.

If `self` is unbound, this function returns `NULL`.

get_position.brief: Gets the position in the model that `self` currently displays.
get_position.md:
Gets the position in the model that `self` currently displays.

If `self` is unbound, %GTK_INVALID_LIST_POSITION is returned.

get_selectable.brief: Checks if the row has been set to be selectable via gtk_column_view_row_set_selectable().
get_selectable.md:
Checks if the row has been set to be selectable via
gtk_column_view_row_set_selectable().

Do not confuse this function with [`ColumnViewRow.get_selected()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnViewRow#method:get_selected).

get_selected.brief: Checks if the item is selected that this row corresponds to.
get_selected.md:
Checks if the item is selected that this row corresponds to.

The selected state is maintained by the list widget and its model
and cannot be set otherwise.

set_accessible_description.brief: Sets the accessible description for the row, which may be used by e.g. screen readers.
set_accessible_description.md:
Sets the accessible description for the row,
which may be used by e.g. screen readers.

set_accessible_label.brief: Sets the accessible label for the row, which may be used by e.g. screen readers.
set_accessible_label.md:
Sets the accessible label for the row,
which may be used by e.g. screen readers.

set_activatable.md:
Sets `self` to be activatable.

If a row is activatable, double-clicking on the row, using
the Return key or calling gtk_widget_activate() will activate
the row. Activating instructs the containing columnview to
emit the [`ColumnView::activate`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#event:activate) signal.

By default, row are activatable.

set_focusable.md:
Sets `self` to be focusable.

If a row is focusable, it can be focused using the keyboard.
This works similar to [`Widget.set_focusable()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#method:set_focusable).

Note that if row are not focusable, the contents of cells can still be focused if
they are focusable.

By default, rows are focusable.

set_selectable.md:
Sets `self` to be selectable.

If a row is selectable, clicking on the row or using the keyboard
will try to select or unselect the row. Whether this succeeds is up to
the model to determine, as it is managing the selected state.

Note that this means that making a row non-selectable has no
influence on the selected state at all. A non-selectable row
may still be selected.

By default, rows are selectable.

accessible-label.md: The accessible label to set on the row.
